title: Securing Large Language Models: Threats, Vulnerabilities and Responsible Practices

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies (e.g., Deshpande et al.) that prompt LLMs with specific assigned personas and evaluate the resulting toxicity levels in the generated text to identify skewed behaviors and risks related to different genders.

Reviewing studies that assign different personas to LLMs and measure the varying degrees of toxicity in the outputs to determine if specific ethnicities face a disproportionate risk of encountering toxic content.
